name: hmk-platform
description: HMK AI & Robotics Club — Web-Based Digital Management Platform (نادي الهمك للذكاء الصنعي والروبوتيك)

scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --project-id $SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF --schema public > src/lib/supabase/database.types.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:db && npm run i18n:check
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e

stack-notes: Next.js 16 App Router + React 19.2 — Server Components by default; Supabase access happens server-side.
@supabase/ssr is the ONLY supported cookie-based auth bridge for the App Router; do not use auth-helpers (deprecated).
next-intl v4 provides the ar/en routing, ICU messages and the RTL/LTR dir switch.
zustand holds client-only global state: theme, locale preference, and UI shell state. It NEVER caches server data.
next-themes drives the dark/light class on <html>; zustand mirrors the choice for components that need it during SSR.
Playwright is scoped to the BR-01 clearance-lock and dual-language regression suites.
//.version-policy: Ranges are carets. Run `npm install` then commit package-lock.json to freeze exact versions before the first deploy.
